items.name: MS Project Server
items.summary: Microsoft Project is software for planning, scheduling, and tracking tasks, resources, and timelines on complex projects.
items.intro: Sync tasks, timelines, and milestones between Tactic and Microsoft Project automatically, then follow resource allocation and progress in Power BI dashboards.
items.how_heading: How Tactic synchronizes timelines with Microsoft Project
items.how_text: Manage schedules, dependencies, and milestones in Microsoft Project while Tactic keeps those timelines aligned with portfolio strategy.
steps: Connect your Tactic workspace to Microsoft Project from system settings.
Import project templates, timelines, and task hierarchies into Tactic.
Link individual tasks to specific projects and assign dependencies.
Use dashboards in Tactic to track real-time progress synced from MS Project.

items.name: Office 365
items.summary: Office 365 is Microsoft's cloud-based productivity suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and more.
items.intro: Elevate your productivity by integrating Tactic with Office 365.
steps: Link your Tactic user accounts with Office 365 credentials.
Sync shared calendars to reflect project milestones and events.
Enable document sharing and editing via OneDrive or SharePoint.
Allow real-time comments on shared files directly from Tactic.
Track activity and collaboration metrics in Tactic reports.

items.name: SAP
items.summary: SAP is an enterprise resource planning (ERP) suite used to run finance, procurement, and operations.
items.intro: Connect Tactic to SAP through the Tactic Integration Hub to keep project and financial data in step. Contact us to scope the integration for your SAP landscape.

items.name: MS Excel
items.summary: Microsoft Excel is spreadsheet software used for data analysis, calculations, charting, and reporting.
items.intro: Power your data analysis by integrating Tactic with Microsoft Excel.
items.how_heading: How Tactic works with MS Excel
steps: Export datasets from Tactic directly into Excel workbooks.
Use Excel formulas or pivot tables to analyze resource allocation or costs.
Create custom charts based on project KPIs.
Set up scheduled data exports for recurring reports.
Link Excel files back into Tactic for centralized access.

items.name: Zoom
items.summary: Zoom is a cloud-based video conferencing platform for virtual meetings, webinars, and team collaboration.
items.intro: Streamline your communications by linking Tactic with Zoom. Schedule meetings, invite stakeholders, and launch video calls from project dashboards, with attendance, duration, and recordings flowing back into Tactic.
steps: Connect your Zoom account to Tactic via the integration settings.
Schedule project meetings directly from task or milestone views.
Automatically generate Zoom links and send invites to team members.
Record meeting attendance, duration, and summary in Tactic.
Access past meeting logs and recordings from within the project timeline.

items.name: Oracle
items.summary: Oracle is an enterprise software suite for database management, ERP, and financial systems.
items.intro: Unlock enterprise-grade data integrity by linking Tactic to Oracle, keeping transactional records, client data, and project metrics in sync across systems.
steps: Set up API integration between Tactic and Oracle Cloud/ERP.
Sync chart of accounts and budget codes.
Automate invoice generation and expense tracking from Tactic.
Use Oracle reporting tools to generate financial dashboards.
Monitor audit trails for all synced transactions.

items.name: Power BI
items.summary: Power BI is Microsoft's business analytics tool for visualizing data and sharing insights through interactive dashboards.
items.intro: Gain actionable insights by integrating Tactic with Power BI. Project, resource, and financial data feeds interactive dashboards that surface trends and support data-driven decisions.
items.how_heading: How Tactic works with Power BI
steps: Connect Tactic to Power BI using direct query or dataset export.
Build visualizations for timeline, resource usage, or performance KPIs.
Enable auto-refresh to reflect updated metrics.
Share dashboards with project stakeholders.
Embed reports back into Tactic for centralized access.

items.name: MS Teams
items.summary: Microsoft Teams combines chat, video meetings, file sharing, and team communication in one place.
items.intro: Collaborate seamlessly with Tactic by integrating Microsoft Teams.
items.how_heading: How Tactic works with MS Teams
steps: Integrate your Tactic environment with your Teams workspace.
Auto-create dedicated Teams channels for new projects.
Post automatic updates for tasks, milestones, or changes.
Enable file sharing and inline commenting through Teams.
Track collaboration metrics and chat logs from within Tactic.

items.name: ServiceNow
items.summary: ServiceNow is a cloud-based IT service management platform for handling incidents, requests, and workflows.
items.intro: Enhance your project support by integrating Tactic with ServiceNow.
steps: Establish the connection between Tactic and your ServiceNow instance.
Configure rules to automatically create incidents based on project events.
Assign and track incident resolution within project dashboards.
Sync status updates and resolution notes between both systems.
Generate support performance reports tied to project progress.
